# Adimensional

Source: [`Kernel/Adimensional.wl`](../../Kernel/Adimensional.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#adimensional-kerneladimensionalwl--adimensionalequations)

AdimensionalEquations: from the dimensionful equations d\_s(comb) = Integral d^dq/(2 Pi)^d (integrand) and the derived dimensions, the dimensionless beta functions of the state couplings, split into a linear part (no momentum integral) and a loop part (integrand of Integral daq), and the linear system for the anomalous dimensions eta\_j of the reference couplings. Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "Adimensional".

## Symbols

### `AdimensionalEquations`

`AdimensionalEquations[equations, dims, "State" -> {gk, lk, ...}]` returns the "Adimensional" stage: for each state coupling c (dimensionless name chat) d\_s chat = BetaL + Integral daq `Measure[aq]` BetaNL, and the eta system (EtaML + Integral daq Measure EtaMNL) eta = EtaBL + Integral daq Measure EtaBNL. d\_s ref\_j = -eta\_j ref\_j.

### `ShowBeta`

`ShowBeta[adim, c]` prints the dimensionless flow of the state coupling c: linear part, loop integrand, atoms used.

### `ShowEtaSystem`

`ShowEtaSystem[adim]` prints the eta system row by row (running references: eta from their equation; fixed references: placeholder row eta = 0, to be fixed at run time with FlowRG fixed\_etas).

### `AdimAtom`

`AdimAtom[a, b, m, j]` is a dimensionless propagator atom (the scale-stripped atom `ScaleAtom[a, b, m, j]` in dimensionless couplings and aq); its value is `adim["Atoms"][AdimAtom[...]]`.

### `ShowCausalPoles`

`ShowCausalPoles[adim]` prints the causal-pole conditions in minimal dimensionless form: each entry must be > 0 at every aq (exported as causal\_poles; design/CAUSALITY.md).

### `LoopMeasure`

`LoopMeasure[d, aq]` = 2 Pi^(d/2)/`Gamma[d/2]` aq^(d-1)/(2 Pi)^d: Integral d^dq/(2 Pi)^d f(q^2) = k^d Integral daq `LoopMeasure[d, aq]` f(k^2 aq^2).
